title: One act of the registry's tools on an id (<home>/state/registry-live/journal.jsonl)
description: What the tools themselves did or held while notes were written and committed: a rung lowered or raised, a name found in a store, a store's name that differs, a duplicate folded, addresses turned into ids, a refusal. Appended by `registry note`, `registry commit` and `registry tidy`; read by `registry digest`.

act.description: lowered, raised: the rung moved to what the evidence carries (from, to, why); matched: a store holds the id's name (store, tie); differs: a store holds another name for the function (store, name); folded: an unnamed id became the named id at its address (into); turned: addresses in sentences became ids (count) or were written with their binary and build (qualified), the rest not placed (left); stale: addresses of a build a reanchor could not carry to the new one (count, why); collapsed: repeated sentences of evidence became one (count); refused: a note or a commit was refused (why); held: a clash not settled held the id (why).

member.description: The field or value the act is about, when it is not the entry itself.
